verdict.rationale: Payout reconciliation is a fair axis for a POS product. The evidence only offers a generic pricing-page mention of 'reporting and analytics', with nothing about payouts, daily takings reconciliation, or itemized transaction and fee reports. The generic reporting claim is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports
